title: docs(jobs): a job body's default locale and time zone are the server's
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_
Fixes #29202
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：定时任务文档 `jobs.mdx` 在 `Intl.DateTimeFormat` 那条说明里补两句话：不传语言和 `timeZone` 时用的是服务器的默认语言和时区，要稳定输出就显式传 `timeZone`（和语言）。
- 为什么改：开发者本地跑和服务器跑会得到不同的日期，文档之前没提醒；这是 #29031 合约复审点名的后续。
- 风险与回滚：纯文档，不改代码、不发布任何包；回滚即还原这 5 行。
- 先看：`content/docs/automation/jobs.mdx` 第 199–203 行（新增的两句与示例）。
- 两分钟验证：打开文档站「Jobs」页的沙箱一节，`Intl.DateTimeFormat` 那条下应看到 “server's default locale and time zone” 与 `{ timeZone: 'UTC' }` 示例。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One addition to the `Intl.DateTimeFormat` bullet in `content/docs/automation/jobs.mdx` (+5 / -0): a formatter built with no locale or `timeZone` uses the server's default locale and time zone, and its `resolvedOptions()` reports them; a body should pass `timeZone` (and a locale) for output that does not depend on where it runs, with `new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: 'UTC' })` as the example. No code change.

## Tests

None owed: docs only, no tested behaviour changes. The statement was measured before it was written (below).

## Acceptance notes

- The wiring that backs the sentence: the VM-side constructor in `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/sandbox-intl.ts` snapshots `locales` / `options`; with neither given the snapshot is empty, `readSnapshot` hands `undefined` / `undefined` to the host, and `installSandboxIntl` builds `new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locales, options)` with the host's own `Intl`, so the host's defaults apply. `QuickJSScriptRunner.execute()` in `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts` calls `installSandboxIntl(vm)` for every body kind.
- Hook and action pages (`content/docs/automation/hooks.mdx`, `content/docs/automation/hook-bodies.mdx`, `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx`) do not carry the `Intl.DateTimeFormat` bullet, so there is nothing to mirror there; the jobs bullet already says hook and action bodies get the same formatter.
- No changeset: `content/docs` ships in no package's `files[]`, so `skip-changeset`.

## Verification

<details><summary>Measured: a no-option formatter answers the host's locale and zone</summary>

A scratch script installed `installSandboxIntl` into a fresh QuickJS context (the same call `execute()` makes) and evaluated `new Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions()` and `.format(0)` inside the VM, beside a formatter given `'en-US', { timeZone: 'UTC' }`, under three host settings:

| Host `TZ` / locale | No-option `resolvedOptions()` | No-option `format(0)` | Pinned `format(0)` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `Asia/Tokyo` / `de_DE` | `de-DE`, `Asia/Tokyo` | `1.1.1970` | `1/1/1970` |
| `America/New_York` / `de_DE` | `de-DE`, `America/New_York` | `31.12.1969` | `1/1/1970` |
| `Asia/Tokyo` / `en_GB` | `en-GB`, `Asia/Tokyo` | `01/01/1970` | `1/1/1970` |

Each no-option row equals the host's own `new Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions()` in the same process; the pinned formatter answers the same in all three. The script was not committed.
</details>
